description: Add sync status indicator (saved/saving/offline pill badge) and auto-refresh from Firestore on tab visibility change.
steps: Modify firestoreService.js: add status callback support to saveToFirestore, add lastSavedTimestamp to saved data, export loadFromFirestore for refresh usage.
Modify App.jsx imports: add Cloud, CloudOff, Loader2 from lucide-react.
Add syncStatus state and lastCheckTimestamp ref to App.jsx.
Modify save calls to pass status callback and track sync state.
Add SyncIndicator component rendered as fixed-position pill in bottom-left corner.
Add visibility-change listener for auto-refresh from Firestore.
acceptance_criteria: Sync indicator shows Saved/Saving/Offline states with appropriate icons and colors
Indicator auto-fades after a few seconds in Saved state
Auto-refresh checks Firestore when tab becomes visible (with 10s minimum interval)
lastSavedTimestamp is included in Firestore document
npm run build succeeds with no errors
